definition: modal = most frequent normalised turn-row answer per (grid, arm), ties by earliest first occurrence; counterfactual = modal graded at a checkpoint turn it did not appear at; observed = the string emitted at that turn; era A = tools off
method_three_sentences: Modal: turn rows only (kind absent or 'turn'; tool-followup excluded), normalised strip+collapse-whitespace+casefold, highest count of turns, ties by earliest first occurrence in turn order.
Every encoded turn of the arm counts toward the frequency (denominator is the arm's turn rows, not 12).

Each modal is parsed by grade_v5.parse_answer_contract and graded by grade_v5.grade_cell against grade_v5.derive_truth(LR-01.v6.json) at all 12 ids; grading a modal at a turn it did not appear at is COUNTERFACTUAL and is labelled as such.
